title: Nawarla Gabarnmang and Kakadu rock art
note: Arnhem Land rock shelter with dated ground-edge axes and painted ceiling, among Kakadu's rock-art sequence.

title: Eureka Stockade
note: Ballarat goldfield miners' revolt of 3 December 1854 over licence fees and representation.

title: Mabo v Queensland (No 2)
note: High Court overturned terra nullius and recognised native title on 3 June 1992.

title: Hokule'a voyage to Tahiti
note: Non-instrument Polynesian voyaging canoe sailed Hawaii to Tahiti in 1976, proving deliberate settlement voyaging.

title: Overthrow of the Hawaiian Kingdom
note: Queen Liliuokalani deposed on 17 January 1893 by a US-backed committee.

title: Ha'amonga 'a Maui trilithon
note: Tongan coral-limestone trilithon about 5 m high built by the Tu'i Tonga, with published slab dimensions.

title: Tu'i Tonga maritime chiefdom
note: Tongan paramountcy projecting power over Samoa, Fiji and Niue.

title: Kokoda Track campaign
note: Australian defence of Port Moresby along the Owen Stanley Range, July to November 1942, with named stops.

title: Abel Tasman voyage of 1642
note: VOC voyage reaching Van Diemen's Land, New Zealand, Tonga and Fiji with dated landfalls.

title: Cook's first Pacific voyage (Endeavour)
note: Tahiti transit of Venus, New Zealand circumnavigation and the east coast of Australia, 1768-1771.

title: Federation of Australia
note: Six colonies unite under the Commonwealth Constitution.

title: Budj Bim aquaculture system
note: Gunditjmara basalt-channel eel trap system, among the world's oldest aquaculture engineering.

title: Sydney Harbour Bridge
note: Steel arch bridge with published span, height and deck dimensions.

title: Bikini Atoll nuclear tests
note: Operation Crossroads and later tests displaced the Bikinians and contaminated the Marshall Islands.

title: Tupaia's chart of the Pacific
note: Raiatean navigator drew a map of some 74 islands for Cook, preserving Polynesian geography.

title: Oruanui supereruption of Taupo
note: Taupo eruption of about 1,170 km3, the youngest supereruption, shaping New Zealand's central North Island.

title: Gonur Tepe
note: Bactria-Margiana Archaeological Complex citadel in Turkmenistan with excavated fortified plan.

title: Botai horse domestication
note: Kazakh steppe site with the earliest evidence of horse herding and milking.

title: Andronovo and Indo-Iranian migrations
note: Dated steppe-to-Iran and India movements from Sintashta and Andronovo cultures.

title: Pazyryk kurgans and Issyk gold man
note: Frozen Scythian-Saka burials in the Altai and the Issyk golden warrior of Kazakhstan.

title: Xuanzang's journey to India
note: Tang monk from Chang'an across Turfan, Samarkand and the Hindu Kush to Nalanda, 629-645.

title: Semipalatinsk test site
note: First Soviet atomic test (29 August 1949) and 456 tests on the Kazakh steppe.

title: Itchan Kala of Khiva
note: Walled inner city of the Khanate of Khiva with the Kalta Minor minaret and Islam Khoja minaret about 45 m.

title: Mausoleum of Khoja Ahmed Yasawi
note: Timurid mausoleum in Turkestan with a 18 m portal and a large ribbed dome.

title: Kazakh Khanate
note: Steppe polity founded by Janibek and Kerei breaking from Abu'l-Khayr.

title: Saka and Scythian steppe peoples
note: Mounted nomads of the Eurasian steppe from the Black Sea to the Tien Shan.

title: Bukhara historic centre
note: Kalyan minaret (about 47 m) and Ismail Samani mausoleum.

title: Sukhothai
note: First Thai kingdom capital, with Wat Mahathat chedi and Ramkhamhaeng inscription.

title: Imperial City of Hue
note: Nguyen dynasty citadel with published walls of about 2.5 km each side.

title: Ban Chiang
note: Thai prehistoric site with early bronze metallurgy and painted pottery.

title: Banaue Rice Terraces
note: Ifugao terraces in Luzon covering about 10,000 km2 of mountain slopes.

title: Bataan Death March
note: About 100 km forced march from Mariveles to San Fernando, April 1942, with named stops.

title: Philippine Revolution
note: Katipunan uprising against Spain, and the 1898 declaration of independence.

title: August Revolution in Vietnam
note: Viet Minh seizure of power and 2 September 1945 declaration of independence.

title: Majapahit
note: Javanese thalassocracy and its Nagarakretagama.

title: Funan and Oc Eo
note: Mekong delta trading state linking India, China and Rome.

title: Ho Chi Minh Trail
note: Supply network from North Vietnam through Laos and Cambodia, with named waypoints.

title: Eruption of Mount Pinatubo
note: Second largest eruption of the 20th century, cooling the globe by about 0.5 C.

title: Petronas Towers
note: Twin towers 451.9 m tall with a skybridge at the 41st floor.

title: Burma-Thailand Death Railway
note: 415 km railway and Bridge on the River Kwai built with forced labour of POWs and romusha.

title: Indonesian mass killings of 1965-66
note: Anti-communist massacres of roughly 500,000 people after the 30 September Movement.

title: Jose Rizal
note: Novelist of Noli Me Tangere whose 1896 execution catalysed the Philippine Revolution.

title: Magellan in the Philippines
note: Landfalls at Homonhon, Limasawa and Cebu, and death at Mactan on 27 April 1521.

title: Bandung Conference
note: Afro-Asian conference in Indonesia.

title: Strait of Magellan
note: Magellan's dated 38-day passage of the strait, October to November 1520.

title: Kon-Tiki expedition
note: Heyerdahl's balsa raft from Callao to Raroia, 28 April to 7 August 1947.

title: First transatlantic telegraph cable
note: Cable between Valentia Island and Newfoundland, 3,200 km, 1858, then permanent in 1866.

title: Battle of the Atlantic
note: Longest continuous campaign of WWII.

title: Bellingshausen sights Antarctica
note: Russian circumnavigation of Antarctica, first sighting of the continent in January 1820.

title: Mawson's Australasian Antarctic Expedition
note: Far Eastern Party sledge journey and Mawson's solo survival, 1912-13.

title: Vostok and EPICA ice cores
note: Ice cores recording 800,000 years of CO2 and temperature.

title: Opening of the Drake Passage
note: Tectonic opening of the Antarctic Circumpolar Current.

title: Mutiny on the Bounty
note: 28 April 1789 mutiny, Bligh's 6,700 km open-boat voyage to Timor and Pitcairn settlement.

title: Voyage of HMS Beagle
note: Darwin's circumnavigation including the Galapagos, 1831-1836.

title: Hawaiian-Emperor seamount chain
note: Hotspot track recording the 47 Ma bend in Pacific plate motion.

title: Storegga Slide tsunami
note: Submarine landslide off Norway sent a tsunami across the North Sea and flooded Doggerland.

title: Great Trek
note: Voortrekker routes from the Cape Colony to Natal and Transvaal, with the Blood River battle on 16 December 1838.

title: Leptis Magna
note: Septimius Severus's home city with arch, basilica and harbour.

title: Zaghouan-Carthage aqueduct
note: Roman aqueduct about 132 km long with a 62 km main run.

title: Library of Alexandria
note: Ptolemaic research library.

title: Ibn Battuta's travels
note: Tangier to Mecca, India, China and Mali with dated stops, 1325-1354.

title: San Martin's crossing of the Andes
note: Army of the Andes route from Mendoza to Chacabuco, January-February 1817.

title: Itaipu Dam
note: 7,919 m long, 196 m high binational dam.

title: Brasilia
note: Planned capital by Costa and Niemeyer built 1956-1960.

title: Taq Kasra at Ctesiphon
note: Largest brick vault, 37 m wide and 37 m high.

title: Hejaz Railway
note: 1,300 km railway from Damascus to Medina.

title: Qanat irrigation systems
note: Underground channels with Gonabad qanat 45 km.

title: Shahnameh
note: Ferdowsi's epic of 50,000 couplets.

title: Dholavira
note: Harappan city with stepped reservoirs and a published water system.

title: Chand Baori stepwell
note: 13-storey stepwell about 30 m deep.

title: Grand Trunk Road
note: Road from Kabul to Kolkata rebuilt by Sher Shah Suri.

title: Mahabharata
note: Sanskrit epic of 100,000 verses.

title: Zhaozhou Bridge
note: Oldest segmental arch bridge, 37 m span.

title: Dujiangyan irrigation system
note: Li Bing's weir-free irrigation of the Min River, still working.

title: Long March
note: About 9,000 km retreat from Ruijin to Yan'an with named stops.

title: Akashi Kaikyo Bridge
note: Suspension bridge with a 1,991 m main span.

title: Messinian Salinity Crisis and Zanclean flood
note: Mediterranean desiccation ending in the Zanclean megaflood at 5.33 Ma.

title: Laki eruption
note: Icelandic fissure eruption causing famine and haze across the northern hemisphere.

title: Carrington solar storm
note: Strongest recorded geomagnetic storm, disabling telegraph networks on 1-2 September 1859.

title: Minoan eruption of Thera
note: Santorini caldera-forming eruption that buried Akrotiri.

title: Oceanic Anoxic Event 2
note: Cenomanian-Turonian ocean anoxia and black shale deposition.

title: Valdivia earthquake
note: Largest instrumentally recorded earthquake, M9.5 on 22 May 1960, with Pacific-wide tsunami.

title: Little Ice Age
note: Centuries of cooler climate with advancing alpine glaciers and volcanic forcing.

title: Rumi
note: Persian poet of the Masnavi, from Balkh to Konya.

title: Confucius
note: Teacher whose Analects shaped East Asian statecraft.

title: Code of Hammurabi
note: Babylonian law stele of 282 laws.

title: Magna Carta
note: Charter limiting royal power at Runnymede.

title: William Shakespeare
note: Playwright of Hamlet and the Globe.

title: First Transcontinental Railroad
note: Union Pacific and Central Pacific joined at Promontory Summit.

title: Chaco Canyon
note: Pueblo Bonito of 600 rooms.
